subject: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Cc: partners@federated-io.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables

Team / Sarah,

We kick off the quarter next week and I want to lock down the cascade plan and what we’ll present at the joint QBR with Acme on June 10. Goals for this thread:

- Confirm owners for the top-level objectives and second-tier key results.
- Agree on milestones we can commit to in the QBR deck.
- Surface any resource gaps that would materially change timelines.
- Agree a short sign-off cadence (owner confirmation by Tue 5/25, final QBR slides by Fri 6/4).

I’ve attached a working cascade (Q2_OKR_cascade.xlsx) with suggested owners in yellow. Please:
- Owners: review the sheet and reply with ACK or propose alternate owner.
- Marcus: flag any capacity risks (if you have a quick delta, paste it inline).
- Monica: can you take point on the QBR slide template and slot owners into the deck?

Sarah — thanks for joining our kickoff. For the joint QBR, we’re aiming to present the objectives, the measures we’ll use to evaluate progress at mid-quarter, and one customer success story. If Acme has a specific ask for metrics, drop them here and we’ll include them in the deck.

Next steps: owner ACKs by Tue 5/25 EOD, draft QBR deck by Mon 6/7 (internal review), final slides by Fri 6/4 (two-day buffer for exec review).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_OKR_cascade.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables

Grace — ACK on the owners I have highlighted. Small tweaks below (inline):

- Objective 1 (Platform reliability): keep Marcus as owner, but shift KR2 (latency 95p) to me for operational oversight.
- Objective 3 (Developer experience): I can take the doc-level owner and loop with Developer Experience for the microsurvey we agreed on.

Monica — I’ll drop the microsurvey questions into the cascade sheet by EOD.

Quick ask: can we include a single-slide risk heatmap in the QBR deck? Should help frame the discussion with Acme.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables

Thanks — ACK on platform ownership changes. Two things to call out:

1) Capacity: the tentative scheduling for model evaluation + rollouts in weeks 3–6 of the quarter will overlap with a partner benchmark run. That increases our expected GPU demand by ~18% during the peak window. See attached quick analysis.
2) Contingency: if we can shift the rollout window by one week or accept a lighter eval pass (perf-only for non-critical models), we can stay within current capacity.

I’ve attached capacity-impact-analysis.pdf with traffic assumptions and the two mitigation options. Let me know which you prefer and I’ll convert into a short slide for the QBR.

- Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

Attachments: capacity-impact-analysis.pdf (pdf stub)

Date: 2027-05-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables

Thanks Grace — this looks good. A couple quick notes from Acme: 

- We’d like to see a short metrics appendix (page in the deck) that maps your KRs to the customer-facing metrics we track (MTTR, API error rate, average latency for our 95p).
- For the customer story, can we highlight the on-boarding time reduction you achieved last quarter? Our DevOps team will make a small slide to show the environment parity outcomes. You can loop devops@acme.com for assets.

We’re happy with the owner timeline you proposed; will plan to send any materials from our side by Tue 6/1.

—Sarah
Sarah Patel
Chief Technology Officer, Acme Corp

Planned deliverables: 
- Draft deck (internal): Mon 6/7
- Draft deck (shared with Acme for feedback): Tue 6/8
- Final slides: Fri 6/4 (keeping the sign-off buffer you suggested, Grace).

Marcus — I added an optional single-slide risk heatmap (per Lauren) and a capacity slide pulling from your PDF; please review and confirm the numbers by EOD 5/24.

Date: 2027-05-24T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OKR cascade & QBR readiness — owners, timeline, and deliverables

All — ACK and I confirm the owner roster in the cascade sheet. Two quick items from Finance/GTN: 

1) For any objective that expects more than a 10% incremental spend (Marcus’s capacity mitigation options), please include a short cost delta line in the QBR deck so we can expedite approval if needed.
2) For the Acme joint metric appendix, I’ll pull the historical numbers and add a one-slide visualization. Expect it in the draft deck by 6/7.

With that, consider owners locked unless I hear objections by EOD 5/25. Great cross-functional coordination so far.

—Karthik
VP, GTN & Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
